name: sommer-bot
description: discord bot for the discord server sommer
author: sheqq

scripts.generate:api: openapi-generator-cli generate --input-spec src/api/sommer-facade.yaml --generator-name javascript --output src/api/generated --additional-properties=usePromises=true,projectName=sommer-api-client && esbuild src/api/generated/src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=src/api/generated/client.cjs
scripts.prebuild: npm run generate:api && redocly build-docs src/api/sommer-facade.yaml --output docs/api.html
scripts.test: npm run check && node scripts/test-jsonService.js && node scripts/test-apiClient.js && node scripts/test-levels.js && node scripts/test-colorRoles.js && node scripts/test-createColorCommand.js
